verdict.rationale: Resend documents registrable webhooks through a create-webhook API for real-time email event notifications, and a hands-on community user confirms webhooks with logging. The pack does not name delivered, bounced or complained events, and says nothing about retry behavior. missing for 10: explicit documentation of delivered/bounced/complained event types, documented retry/backoff behavior, independent corroboration of delivery reliability.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can receive webhooks for delivered, bounced, and complained events with documented retry behavior, so my app reacts to email outcomes in real time

citations.quote: Create a webhook to receive real-time notifications about email events.
configure webhooks, and monitor delivery events.
Build custom headless webhook experiences from the API, SDKs, CLI, and MCP server.
